name: 23881 · Spring Grove, VA
findings: ZIP 23881 (Spring Grove) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23881 (Spring Grove) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
